title: Mango Tart
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: In a chopper,add digestive biscuits & chop well.
steps.romanUrdu: Chopper mein digestive biscuits dal ker ache tarhan chop ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add melted butter,cinnamon powder,cardamom powder & chop until well combined.
steps.romanUrdu: Melted makhan,darchini powder aur elaichi powder dal dein aur ache tarhan chop ker lein.

steps.instruction: Now transfer mixture to 8” inch silicon pan,press firmly down into the base to create an even layer and refrigerate for 2 hours or until set.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab mixture ko 8” inch silicon pan mein dal ker evenly pheela lein aur press ker ka layer tayyar ker lein aur set hunay tak 2 hours kliya refrigerate ker lein.

steps.instruction: In a bowl,add cream cheese & beat until fluffy.
steps.romanUrdu: Bowl mein cream cheese dal ker fluffy hunay tak ache tarhan beat ker lein.

steps.instruction: Add mango puree,beat again & set aside.
steps.romanUrdu: Mango puree dal ker dubara beat ker lein & side per rakh dein.

steps.instruction: In a large bowl,add ice cubes & place another bowl over it,add cream,powderd sugar & beat until soft peaks form.
steps.romanUrdu: Baday bowl mein ice cubes dal dein aur upper sa ek aur bowl rakh dein,cream aur powdered sugar dal ker soft peaks form hunay tak ache tarhan beat ker lein.

steps.instruction: Now add mango puree mixture & beat until well combined.
steps.romanUrdu: Ab mango puree mixture dal ker dein aur ache tarhan beat ker lein.

steps.instruction: Pour prepared mixture in tart shell,spread evenly & refrigerate for 2 hours.
steps.romanUrdu: Tart shell mein tayyar mixture dal ker evenly pheela lein aur 2 hours kliya refrigerator mein rakh dein.

steps.instruction: Cut thin slices of peeled mango and arrange mango slices on top.
steps.romanUrdu: Mango ko thin slices mein cut karein aur mango slices ko top per arrange ker lein.
Desired pieces mein cut ker ka serve karein!

ogDescription: The most beautiful mango recipe from Food Fusion. Try this mango tart recipe and enjoy the mango season with family. #HappyCookingToYou #FoodFusion
